name: Local OAI-compatible LLM
description: Canonical reference provider plugin: OpenAI-compatible chat completions over any HTTP endpoint (vLLM, LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, self-hosted). No API key required by default. Claims the 'local' model prefix and dynamically registers each entry from spore.json's customProviders block (legacy SPORE_PROVIDER_<NAME>_* env vars). Other provider plugins (openai-provider, openrouter-provider) wrap the same OAICompatClient via this plugin's lib.
